candidate.title: NET-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina NET-Seq schematic at the level of native RNAPII elongation-complex immunoprecipitation, RNA extraction and reverse transcription to cDNA. Native elongating transcript sequencing is the expanded name of NET-Seq. The far-left title thumbnail depicts the assay concept; the arrow-connected workflow starts at the icon labelled "Transcriptome complex". There are no depicted branches or alternative target workflows. The matching collection-page heading and RNAPII label, the card description, and the human protocol's retrospective account identify this as an immunoprecipitation-based NET-Seq representation consistent with the original yeast implementation. The diagram ends at cDNA; the card explains its subsequent use for sequencing nascent RNA 3'-ends. This extraction describes that schematic architecture, not a complete sequencing-ready library recipe or every NET-Seq implementation.

states.label: Native RNAPII elongation complex (diagram label: Transcriptome complex)
features: Blue protein oval on a gray template-associated line, with a purple RNA strand extending to a black square labelled Cap.
The biological target is nascent RNA associated with elongating RNA polymerase II, rather than the entire mature transcriptome.
The distal cap icon is preserved as a depicted RNA feature; neither cap selection nor removal is depicted.
The far-left unconnected title icon also shows blue polymerase, RNA and a cap, including a yellow trace. It is a descriptive thumbnail, not a separate material branch.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate complex
operations.description: Captures the native RNAPII elongation complex with antibodies while retaining associated nascent RNA. The output differs from the starting complex by its antibody association and immunoprecipitated selection state.
operations.mechanism: Antibody-mediated immunoprecipitation of the polymerase complex. The full-text protocol identifies C-terminal 3× FLAG-tagged Rpb3 in its account of the original yeast implementation; no antibody epitope or bead chemistry is specified in the drawing.
operations.information_effect: Selects RNA through its physical association with the captured elongation complex, linking the recovered nascent transcripts to RNAPII transcription. Nonspecific antibody capture can also retain unwanted complexes, so the selected population is not assumed to be perfectly specific.

operations.label: Reverse transcription
operations.description: Copies the extracted RNA into complementary DNA. The paired purple/blue lines illustrate RNA with its DNA copy, and the following arrow ends at the blue cDNA product. These icons are retained within the depicted RNA-to-cDNA conversion; the unlabelled final arrow does not specify an additional RNA-removal chemistry.
operations.mechanism: Reverse transcription of the selected RNA to cDNA; primer design and any subsequent template-removal chemistry are unspecified at this schematic level.
operations.information_effect: Moves the readout carrier from selected RNA to its DNA copy. The card states that subsequent deep sequencing reads nascent RNA 3'-ends, and the original primary-paper abstract supports nucleotide-resolution monitoring of polymerase-associated transcription. The relevant signal is the captured nascent endpoint, not the position of the depicted cap or steady-state mature RNA abundance. Sequencing and detailed construction of an endpoint-preserving library are described as the intended interface, not added as unshown operations.
